A production center belongs to a floor; that is only where it is listed, it can receive orders from any room unless you limit it."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Settings","key":"md_settings","id":"settings","name":"md_settings","value":"# Settings - **Description** and **Color**: how it shows in the production column and on its screen. - **Item Group**: what it prepares. A group includes its subgroups. The burger goes to the station of *Food*, the soda to the one of *Drinks*. - **Status Flow**: the statuses its items go through, in order. The first is how items arrive (normally *Sent*); each tap moves them to the next one; at the last one they leave the station. Examples: - Kitchen: *Sent → Processing → Completed* - Bar: *Sent → Completed* - Expo or dispatch: *Completed → Delivered* Statuses where the waiter can still edit the item (such as *Pending*) can't be part of a flow. See [Order statuses](/Docs/Order%20Statuses). - **Group Items By Order**: on, one ticket per order with all its items (they move together); off, each item is its own card. - **Only some rooms or tables**: the station only gets orders from those rooms or tables. For example a terrace bar. - **Wait for the whole order**: for expo and dispatch. The order shows up as soon as it is sent, with the progress of every item, and its button only works when everything has reached this station. See [Dispatch and drivers](/Docs/Dispatch). - **Kitchen Ticket Printer**: the items this station prepares print there when they are sent. See [Printers](/Docs/Printers)."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Stations share the status of each item","key":"md_stations_share_the_status_of_each_item","id":"stations-share-the-status-of-each-item","name":"md_stations_share_the_status_of_each_item","value":"# Stations share the status of each item An item has one status, shared by every station that handles it. That is how stations chain: the kitchen takes the burger from *Sent* to *Completed*, and the expo, whose flow starts at *Completed*, picks it up from there. Combos can split too: with **Send components to their stations** on the item, the burger of a combo goes to the kitchen and its drink to the bar, each with its own status. See [Options, combos and sizes](/Docs/Options%20and%20Combos)."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Who sees a station","key":"md_who_sees_a_station","id":"who-sees-a-station","name":"md_who_sees_a_station","value":"# Who sees a station People see the screens of the stations assigned to them in [Ren Staff](/Docs/Staff%20and%20Roles), or all of them if their role has **Every production center**. Managers see all of them."}}]}]
